answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the falcon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the canyon of a task receipt, and the sonnet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
